The allegation is false on the reviewed current producer Proof 2.1. Locally a tree midpoint has a scalar edge coordinate. In the least simplex sigma containing a level point, the affine coordinate cannot be constant: otherwise its vertices would also map to the midpoint, excluded by construction. Choose two vertices p,q of sigma with different values and positive barycentric coordinates at the point. Replacing their coordinates by lambda_p+t and lambda_q-t works on every simplex containing sigma, agrees on their shared faces, and changes the function by t(f(p)-f(q)). Solving for t gives a compatible local PL level product across the whole star, including edge and face links. In a combinatorial manifold its transverse slice is a 2-ball; the boundary already has its fixed regular product collar. Thus sheets cannot branch as alleged. Grunert (2016), Corollary 2.40(2) and Lemma 3.22 independently prove precisely this local regularity criterion. The smooth-transversality supplier is used later for smooth disk witnesses, not as the justification of this PL assertion. No edit or whole-supplier acceptance is claimed.
